CEO James Heckman announced in partnership with
, an analyst-driven ranking of the top 100 publicly traded technology assets.

Focused on growth - the rating list covers companies focused on semiconductors, cloud and AI software, energy, cybersecurity, fintech, defense, healthcare tech, transportation, media/ad tech, e-commerce, and robotics.
is published in partnership with TheStreet.com, and distributed across dozens of financial publications, reaching hundreds of millions of investment viewers across the globe.

The ranking reviews hundreds of eligible assets; equities listed on Nasdaq, the NYSE, or digital assets available on U.S.- accessible exchanges, such as Coinbase. The updated ranking will be published each Friday after market close.

The rankings are the work of a Committee of tech veterans, including world-class investors, tech operators and analysts who have spent their careers inside the sectors they are scoring. Experts and raw data score the companies from 0 to 100 on six variables: Team, Innovation, Safety, Value, Growth and Market Dominance. The average of those scores is the company's Power Ranking, which determines its place among the top 100.

Heckman, a 35-year senior tech executive, outlined the opportunity, “The mission is to deliver investors the combined value of our ecosystem of leading tech experts and visionaries. After years building the world’s only AI/DeFi-powered media coalition, our “roundtable” of partners are positioned to deliver collective intelligence on the top 100 tech growth companies globally. We’re excited to deliver a weekly perspective unavailable elsewhere, helping guide this milestone for the industry.”
Roundtable CEO James Heckman with Chairman Walton Comer, CTO Eyal Hertzog, CFO Aly Madhavji, and COO Bill Sornsin. (Source: Nasdaq, Inc. / Vanja Savic)

The Roundtable 100 Tech Committee of investors and analysts includes Heckman; Aly Madhavji, Managing Partner at Blockchain Founders Fund; Walton Comer, 15 years with Steven Cohen as a quant analyst and co-founder and investor in two billion-plus tech ventures; Peter Schiff, Chief Economist and Global Strategist at Euro Pacific Asset Management; Frank Holmes, CEO and Chief Investment Officer of U.S. Global Investors and Executive Chairman of HIVE Digital Technologies; Steven Fletcher, veteran technology investment banker who led Goldman Sachs' Private Placement Group and IT Services sector and began his career at Deloitte & Touche; Sean Hagan, lead market analyst at BTC Inc; James Putra, Managing Director of JP3M; Sam Badawi, analyst at Wolf Financial; John Divine; John Slazas of MktTrade; and Eyal Hertzog, tech legend and founder, inventor of DeFi protocols and the social feed algorithm.

is the world’s only AI/DeFi-powered Enterprise Media Platform, integrating distribution, publishing, monetization, community, syndication and DeFi payment operations powering major media coalition. The Web3 platform was developed over years by CTO Eyal Hertzog, inventor of DeFi technology, and co-founder James Heckman, creator of the first social network, blogging platform, premium ad marketplace (PMP), social-targeted ad platform, and lead digital strategist for both News Corp and Yahoo. For more information, visit rtb.io.
